user.title: Add a floor-heated room
user.description: One entry per room. The controller learns how the room heats up and cools down, then plans the valve ahead of time.

data_description.valves: Thermostats or valve heads on the floor-heating manifold. They are only opened and closed; the room sensor decides.
data_description.room_sensors: Temperature sensors and room thermostats in the room itself, not the valve heads on the manifold. With several, their average is used.
data_description.weather: For the outdoor and sun forecast.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional, used instead of the weather's current temperature.
data_description.schedule: A schedule helper: on means comfort, off means eco. Can be changed later on the room's settings entities.
data_description.window_delay: Close the valve only after a window has been open this long. Short airing doesn't matter to a floor.
data_description.presence: People or trackers. When nobody is home for the away delay, the room drops to the away temperature.
data_description.savings: How much the planner weighs energy against being exactly on target, and how far it lets the room cool outside comfort time.
data_description.cycle: The valve opens at most once per cycle. Longer cycles save battery.

error.missing_entities: Pick at least one valve and one room sensor.

abort.already_configured: A room with this name already exists.

init.title: Room settings
init.description: Temperatures, schedule, calendars and out-of-office times are set with the room's entities (for example on the Heizung dashboard).
